events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Day
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped their seminal debut 'Definitely Maybe'. What's your favourite track from the album that defined a generation?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days in August 1969, featuring iconic performances from artists like Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Woodstock Flashback
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the Woodstock Festival brought half a million people together for three days of peace and music. What's your ultimate Woodstock memory or performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at his Graceland estate on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His legacy as the King of Rock and Roll lives on. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who redefined the electric guitar and left us far too soon. What's the Hendrix riff that still blows your mind?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring its famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable in music history. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde, born September 7, 1951, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your go-to Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher, born September 21, 1972, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite track from the man himself, whether Oasis, Beady Eye or solo?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was first released in the UK on October 24, 1975, to promote his compilation album 'Shaved Fish'.

angles.name: Imagine UK Release
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: The First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. Remember painstakingly syncing your entire CD collection? Good times.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and all his cinematic adventures. What's your favourite Bond film or, more importantly, the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon, born October 9, 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend and Monty Python star John Cleese, born October 27, 1939, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the inimitable John Cleese! What's your all-time favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track from the double LP is your hidden gem?
